release_title: TopUp Net Gateway v1.0.6 (Provider-Aware Gateway & SMS Security)
changelog:
- Strict Provider-Aware Gateway Resolution: bKash, Nagad, and Rocket SMS are strictly isolated even when sharing the same phone number on a single SIM.
- Complete protection against cross-gateway attribution and balance mismatch.
- Missed SMS Inbox Scanner with 24h recovery & background sync.
- High-speed cached dashboard rendering for instant UI response.
- Persistent Gateway credentials across Admin Panel & Companion App.
- Developer Contact button directly opens Telegram (@itsnayon360).
- Production signed release build.
